intro: Your weekday dinners feel calm and effortless with Trento. A smooth auto twist glass top extends at both ends, adding legroom and stability while the table grows easily when extra company drops in.

features.title: Auto twist extension for instant space
features.text: Extend the top smoothly at both ends with a synchronized mechanism that feels light to operate, so you can seat more without lifting, dragging, or breaking the flow of serving and conversation.

features.title: Sanded tempered glass that stays pristine
features.text: A 10 mm sanded tempered glass top with a high scratch-resistant marble finish keeps everyday scuffs at bay, protecting the calm, contemporary look you love through daily use and big occasions.

features.title: Legroom designed to feel easy
features.text: Optimized leg space keeps four diners comfortable every day and opens up naturally for six when extended, so knees and bags find room without awkward shuffling under the table.

features.title: Stable metal frame you can trust
features.text: A powder-coated metal understructure, metal frame and plate, plus a locking mechanism, deliver reassuring stability that lets heavy serveware land with confidence every time.

features.title: Rounded corners for worry-free meals
features.text: A softened profile helps protect passing hips and busy little elbows, so you can lean in to pour, share, and laugh without sharp-edge surprises at everyday dinners or festive spreads.

features.title: Knockdown build that fits your life
features.text: Knockdown construction arrives in two packets for easy entry through doors and lifts, then assembles sturdy, so moving homes or refreshing layouts stays simple from start to finish.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
